name: Reversible Bodywarmer - Fleece Golfcart Pattern
desc: The Reversible Golf Cart Vest Two vests in one, so there's no wrong way to wear it. Flip it and it's a clean, water resistant forest green shell with a stand collar, zip chest pocket, and side pockets, embroidered with the same Fella logo front and back. The fabric is anti-bacterial treated, done to reduce odor during those hot and sunny days. Model Phil is 1.82 and wearing a size M.

desc: Lightweight and breathable, the Tech Ripstop Anorak Jacket is built for movement on and off the course. Finished with a rubber script logo at the front and a clean heat-pressed logo at the back neck, this is a functional layer designed for golf, but built to carry beyond it. The ones who catch it clean, flight it low, and make it look easier than it should be. Finished with the Chez Fella back graphic in a butter yellow colourway, because around here, hitting blades like you cut through butter is always on the menu.

name: Cheesy Slice - Graphic Tee
desc: The Cheesy Slice Tee in hunter green. Finished with a melting slice graphic on the back and cut from premium 240GSM carbon-finished cotton with a soft velvet handfeel. Oversized fit. Heavyweight feel. Made for on course, off course, and everything in between.

name: Sandbagger T-Shirt
desc: For the guy who somehow “can’t find his swing” until there’s money on the line. Vintage-inspired sandbagger graphic on a washed cognac tee. Cut from 240GSM carbon-finished cotton with a velvet handfeel that wears soft from day one. Made for early tee times, late rounds, and stories that get better after the scorecard’s signed.

Easy to throw on after a morning round, over swim shorts at the beach, or buttoned up for sunset drinks when the day stretches longer than planned. Model Ihau is 188 cm (6'2'') and wears size L

name: Fella Ripstop Cargo Pant

Pairs well with the Tech Ripstop Anorak Jacket and Cha-Cheng Bucket Hat. Model Juan is 1,98 (6'6'') and wears size 34/34.

name: Lionel Contrast Rib Knit Polo

Breathable, easy to wear, and made for hot summer days when a regular polo feels like too much. The kind of piece that looks right without trying too hard. Sharp on the course, even better after. name: Panel Tech Jacket - Water Repellent
desc: Panel Tech Jacket Stay protected from unexpected rain without compromising style in the Panel Tech Jacket, a high performance golf jacket designed for all conditions on and off the course. Featuring a water repellent outer shell and a modern two tone green and off white panel design, this jacket delivers both weather protection and a sharp athletic silhouette. Features Engineered for versatility, the Panel Tech Jacket combines a durable water repellent polyester exterior with a soft inner lining for lightweight comfort. The removable hood allows you to adjust quickly to changing weather, while a mesh vent across the back enhances airflow and keeps you cool during active play. Smart storage solutions make this jacket as functional as it is stylish. Waterproof valuables pockets on both the outer shell and inner lining keep essentials secure and dry. Dual magnetic envelope pockets provide easy access with reliable closure, perfect for quick storage on the move. Inside, two oversized mesh drop pockets offer space for bulkier items such as a cap, golf gloves, or extra golf balls. Adjustable Velcro cuffs help create a secure fit while blocking out wind and rain, making this jacket ideal for both the golf course and daily commuting. The Panel Tech Jacket defines modern golfwear with a focus on performance, protection, and elevated design. Built for movement and designed to stand out. Model Juan is 1.96 m tall and wears size XL.
